input.label: CONTRADICTED

contradicting_evidence.quote: Net income attributable to common stockholders $ 787 $ 1,373

During the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, our net income attributable to common stockholders was $787 million and $2.38 billion, respectively, representing decreases of $586 million and $576 million, respectively, compared to the same periods in the prior year.

input.reasoning_summary: The claim states that Tesla's net income attributable to common stockholders for Q3 2026 was higher than Q3 2025. However, the evidence clearly contradicts this. Evidence E1 shows that net income attributable to common stockholders for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $787 million compared to $1,373 million for the same period in 2025. Evidence E2 explicitly states this represents a decrease of $586 million compared to the prior year period. Therefore, Q3 2026 net income ($787 million) was lower, not higher, than Q3 2025 ($1,373 million).
